description: Create a new forum channel in a server. A forum holds posts (threads) rather than a linear message feed. Requires the Manage Channels permission. Use discord_create_channel for text/voice channels instead. Returns the new channel's name and ID.

category_id.description: Optional category (snowflake) to nest the forum under.

name.description: Name of the new forum channel (max 100 characters).

topic.description: Guidelines/topic text shown at the top of the forum.

name: discord_create_forum_channel
